name: Zoram Strand
summary: At Ashenvale's northwestern edge, Zoram Strand faces the Veiled Sea. The shore holds the ruins of an ancient night elven city, now overrun by Wrathtail naga, shipwrecks, and beached leviathans. Blackfathom Deeps begins in the submerged temple complex nearby.

sections.title: Ruins of the Sundered Coast
sections.body: Ten thousand years ago, the night elven city of Zoram stood on this coast. The Great Sundering tore Kalimdor apart and sank the settlement beneath the sea. Now the tide brings ancient relics, shattered vessels, and the carcasses of massive sea beasts onto the shore. Wrathtail naga overrun the beaches and tidal pools, guarding the flooded ruins and ancient artifacts from anyone who comes near.

sections.title: A Contested Shoreline
sections.body: Travelers from the mainland and along the coast still come to Zoram Strand despite the naga. South of the shore, the Horde holds Zoram'gar Outpost, where its warriors fight to secure the coast. Nearby, Blackfathom Deeps lies deep within the caverns. The ancient temple of Elune has fallen into dark hands, drawing scouts, scholars, and treasure seekers who brave the surf.

faq.q: What was Zoram before it was destroyed?
faq.answer: Before the Great Sundering ten thousand years ago, Zoram was a grand night elven city. The cataclysm shattered the coast and sank the city beneath the Veiled Sea, leaving jagged ruins and statuettes washed ashore.

faq.q: Who controls the Zoram Strand today?
faq.answer: Wrathtail naga overrun most of the shoreline and defend its shallows and ancient ruins. The Horde holds a fortified outpost along the southern cliffs, while hydras and crabs prowl the sand.

faq.q: Where is the entrance to Blackfathom Deeps?
faq.answer: The entrance to Blackfathom Deeps lies in submerged caverns along Zoram Strand. Travelers enter the coastal caves at the water's edge to reach the descent into the sunken temple.

faq.q: Why are there so many beached sea creatures here?
faq.answer: The Veiled Sea's turbulent tides and dark currents often wash massive marine creatures ashore. Researchers and naturalists from both factions search the remains to learn what drives ocean behemoths to perish along the rocks.

angles.text: For a night elf, Zoram Strand recalls the ancient world lost to the Sundering. Naga now tread among sacred relics and submerged temples to Elune.
For the Horde, defending the approaches to Zoram'gar Outpost helps keep a northern naval and coastal presence in Ashenvale against the relentless Wrathtail brood.
